scientific_integrity: The reported result concerns a mathematically specified scalar jump process and its second-order Gaussian approximation. It is not asserted as a general theorem for arbitrary stochastic resetting.
scientific_limitations: All parameters positive with fixed growth/reset ratio strictly between zero and one.
Growing even-moment comparison assumes m tends to infinity and ms tends to zero.
The stationary critical-moment gap is not a claim of an exact tail prefactor.
The claim has undergone self-review only; independent novelty validation has not been performed.
title: A sharp moment-order crossover for weak Poisson resetting and its diffusion approximation
